the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u011/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows8 = [r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    anchor = min(rows8)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        top = min(r for r, c in cells)
        shift = anchor - top
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r + shift][c] = color
    return out
'''
